Characteristics of Life
7.Living things have adaptations–Modifications that make organisms able to better function in a particular environment–These adaptations have led to the diversity of life on Earth–These adaptations to environments over time also have another name–Evolution–All living things have the capacity to evolve–Allows a way for organisms to persist, despite a changing environment
explanation: This slide presents the seventh characteristic of life: living things have adaptations. Adaptations are modifications that enable organisms to function better in a specific environment, and they are responsible for the vast diversity of life on Earth. Adaptations to environments over long periods of time is also known as evolution. All living things possess the capacity to evolve, which provides a mechanism for organisms to survive and persist despite changing environments.

questions.q: What is defined as modifications that make organisms able to better function in a particular environment?
questions.exp: The text defines adaptations as 'Modifications that make organisms able to better function in a particular environment'.

questions.q: What is the long-term process by which adaptations to environments occur over time, allowing species to persist?
questions.exp: The text states: 'These adaptations to environments over time also have another name – Evolution' and that it 'Allows a way for organisms to persist, despite a changing environment.'
